params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.redacted_image
params.description: The redacted image. The type will be the same as the original image.

params.name: data.extracted_text
params.description: If an image was being inspected and the InspectConfig's include_quote was set to true, then this field will include all text, if any, that was found in the image.

params.name: data.inspect_result
params.description: The findings. Populated when include_findings in the request is true.
